newsitem.title: TURKEY: Cegelec leads in Istanbul subway tender.
newsitem.headline: Cegelec leads in Istanbul subway tender.

text.p: A consortium led by France's Cegelec was the lowest bidder in a second tender held by the Istanbul city council for improvements to a 7.8-km subway line, a city spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
She said Cegelec reduced its bid to $187.5 million from $208.9 million previously.
A rival consortium led by Canada's Bombadier Inc Transportation Systems Division maintained its bid at $282.75 million, she added.
A final decision on the tender was delayed to Thursday, the spokeswoman quoted council general secretary Mustafa Acikalin as saying.
A first tender awarded to a consortium led by Turk Siemens last year for $224 million was cancelled in October.
The 7.8-km line links Istanbul's Levent and Taksim districts. The new tender covers power supply, track laying, signalling, telecommunication, storage facilites and station fittings.
A third consortium led by ABB Traction AB dropped out of the second tender last week due to technical disagreements, the spokeswoman said.
